name: frio - [MMMM]
description: Simply put, the frio makes you slow and stupid. Expect your patients to be numb, clumsy, and frostbitten. Fortunately, there is an easy solution to almost every wintery woe: warm them back up. You will need a crackling fogo, thick blankets, or at the very least, the body heat of a willing volunteer. Do not rewarm them too fast, mind you. Slow and gentle, like thawing meat from the icebox.

results.description: You've been frigid one too many times and your skin easily develops a rash and blisters in frio. Você tem Disadvantage to Constitution checks and saving throws made to resist the environmental effects of frio.
results.name: Chilblains

results.description:
Roll to randomly determine the right or left eye. The frigid air has frozen over the surface layer of your eye. The eye is não funcional. If not treated dentro de 12 horas, your vision will be permanently ausente.

Tratamento - A DC 20 Save Sense Surgery. If the player spends a short rest rewarming the area dentro de 15 minutos of the injury occurring, this DC is decreased to 10.
results.name: Frozen Cornea

results.description:
Roll twice on the @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.vG8gsjqxGB7y9cSD]{Small apêndice Table (Tabela de Apêndices Menores)}. These appendages are firm, frigid, pale, and não funcional. If not treated dentro de 15 minutos they will necrotize and fall off in [[1d4]] dias (after which they are ausente).

Tratamento - A short rest slowly rewarming the appendages.
results.name: Extensive Frostbite

results.description:
Your core body temperature has plummeted dangerously low. While on initiative you function as if affected by both the Slow and Confusion spells. If untreated for one hour, you fall &Reference[unconscious]{unconscious}.

Tratamento - A short rest slowly rewarming yourself ends this effect.
results.name: Severe Hypothermia

results.description: Você está so frio your hands are shaking uncontrollably and your voice quavers as you speak. The next three spells you cast have a 50% chance to fail. This effect ends after three spells are attempted.
results.name: The Shivers

results.description: Your hands are so frio you barely have any feeling in them. Your next three attacks have Disadvantage.
results.name: Frost Nipped Fingers

results.description:
You attempt to move your feet but find the intensity of the frio has frozen you directly to the ground. Você está &Reference[restrained]{restrained}. If Você está flying or otherwise not contacting a surface, there is no effect.

Tratamento - A Strength check (DC equals half the dano that caused the lesão persistente or 10, whichever number is higher) as an action allows you to break free.
results.name: Frozen in Place

results.description:
The extreme frio has leeched away a large amount of your body heat. While on initiative you function as if affected by the Slow spell. If untreated for two horas, the condition advances to Severe Hypothermia.

Tratamento - A short rest slowly rewarming yourself ends this effect.
results.name: Hypothermia

results.description: Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{cicatriz Chart (Tabela de Cicatrizes)}. This body area is left with a pale, blue-tinged cicatriz.
results.name: Pale Blue Dot

results.description: Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{cicatriz Chart (Tabela de Cicatrizes)}. This area of your body has been cryo-branded, and will result in a defined, pale cicatriz. Any hair on the affected area will grow back white.
results.name: frio Brand

results.description: You cannot take the dash action. This effect lasts [[1d6]] rodadas.
results.name: Frost Nipped Toes

results.description: Você está frio. So frio. You stumble. You fumble. You tumble. You mumble and grumble. You cannot take the disengage action for [[1d6]] Turnos.
results.name: The Umbles

results.description: Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{cicatriz Chart (Tabela de Cicatrizes)}. In a freak instance of chance, the frio has interacted with a thread of natural magic dentro de you. This area of your body is permanently frigid (though to you it feels pleasantly cool) and it radiates a faint aura of Transmutation. Você tem Advantage on Constitution checks and saves made to resist the environmental effects of frio. You may suppress this effect by maintaining concentration.
results.name: Heart of Ice

results.description:
Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.vG8gsjqxGB7y9cSD]{Small apêndice Table (Tabela de Apêndices Menores)}. This apêndice is firm, frigid, pale, and não funcional. If not treated dentro de 15 minutos it will necrotize and fall off in [[1d4]] dias (after which it is ausente).

Tratamento - A short rest slowly rewarming O apêndice.
results.name: Frost Bitten apêndice

results.description:
Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.iP8lOROAIYARwcgk]{Large membro Table (Tabela de Membros Maiores)}. seu membro is frozen, rigid, numb, and não funcional. If not treated dentro de 15 minutos O membro will necrotize and fall off in [[1d4]] dias (after which it is ausente)

Tratamento - A short rest slowly rewarming O membro.
results.name: Frost Bitten membro

results.description: The frio has permanently damaged your nerves and your reflexes have become dull and sluggish. Você tem Disadvantage on initiative checks.
results.name: Slowed Reflexes
